user.title: Add a phone
user.description: The phone sends to the address below. It is filled in with the one your browser is using right now. Change it if the phone should use another one: your home network address to sync at home only, or your public address to sync from anywhere.

data_description.name: Becomes the device name. Worth setting with more than one phone in the house.
data_description.base_url: Just the address, without /api/webhook. You can change it later without pairing again.
data_description.use_cloud: Creates a cloudhook, so the phone syncs from anywhere without port forwarding. The address above is then not used.
Creates a cloudhook, so the phone syncs from anywhere without port forwarding. The address above is then not used.
data_description.regenerate_secret: The phone stops syncing until you paste the new secret into both tabs.

error.invalid_url: That is not a full address. It needs the scheme and the host, the way the address bar of your browser shows it: http or https, then the name or IP address, and the port if there is one.
error.cloud_not_connected: Home Assistant Cloud is not connected.

init.title: Send to the phone
init.description: Choose per type of measurement which entity goes to this phone. Leave empty what should not be sent. The app decides which of these it writes to Health Connect, under Receive on its Health Connect tab. Health Connect has no record for BMI, muscle mass or visceral fat, so they are not offered here. Measurements from before this was set up are not sent; the Send history to phone button does that.

data_description.entity: A sensor, number or input number with a mass unit (kg, g, lb, st, oz). Converted to what Health Connect wants.
data_description.time_entity: A timestamp sensor that holds when the measurement was taken, such as a scale's last measurement time. Without one, the moment the value changed in Home Assistant is used.

writeback_permission_denied.title: {phone} refuses {type} from Home Assistant
writeback_permission_denied.description: The Life Dashboard Companion app on {phone} has no permission to write {type} to Health Connect. Open the app, go to Receive on the Health Connect tab and turn {type} on again to grant it. The readings that were refused are not offered again; use Send history to phone once the permission is granted.

writeback_unsupported_type.title: {phone} does not know {type}
writeback_unsupported_type.description: The Life Dashboard Companion app on {phone} is too old to write {type} to Health Connect. Update the app. The readings that were refused are not offered again; use Send history to phone after the update.

queue_history.name: Send history to phone
queue_history.description: Queues the past measurements of the entities mapped to a phone, from the recorder, so the app writes them to Health Connect at its next sync. At most 90 days back, which is how long the queue keeps a reading. Measurements older than 30 days only arrive when Accept older measurements is on in the app. A value that stayed the same is one row in the recorder, so two equal weighings in a row come back as one; for blood pressure the half that did not change takes its last known value. A reading the phone already wrote or refused is not queued again.
